postal_system.postcode_rule: The official Somali Bureau of Standards contact page exposes BN03010 alongside P.O. Box 67, so AGID accepts AA plus five digits as an observed structure and normalizes it to AA NNNNN. One public observation does not prove that every structure-valid value is assigned, mandatory, geographic or current; production validation requires an authoritative assignment artifact and effective date.
postal_system.service_rule: MOCT says sending and receiving mail resumed in May 2025, and the Cabinet approved the National Postal Policy 2025-2030 in January 2026. Service resumption, policy approval, international agreements and an airport office are operational context, not a postcode registry, coverage guarantee or polygon source.
postal_system.identifier_split_rule: Recipient, organization, telephone, P.O. Box, typed postcode, federal or territorial scope, member-state or administration, region, district, municipality, locality, road, premise, civic address, building, parcel, NIRA identity number and AGID remain separate typed objects with independent provenance and validity.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No public authoritative Somali postcode assignment-to-geometry artifact was verified. An administrative unit, enumeration area, service point, road, parcel, building footprint, delivery route, buffer, Voronoi cell, model surface, OSM object and AGID cell are not official postcode polygons. Derived review surfaces remain non-canonical with uncertainty and lineage.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building may be returned only through an explicit rights-cleared authoritative civic-address-to-building relation with stable identifiers. A postcode, P.O. Box, administrative containment, nearest road or footprint, statistical point, parcel overlap, OSM feature and model score are candidate context only.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Every artifact declares its federal, federal-member-state, municipal or other operational territorial scope. AGID does not silently merge or extrapolate separately governed postal, address, statistical, land or infrastructure datasets into nationwide coverage.
postal_system.licence_rule: Government pages and documents are public references but do not automatically grant bulk database redistribution. Statistical, municipal, partner, land, postal and address artifacts require dataset-specific terms, selected fields, purpose, edition and digest. OSM remains a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipient, contact, subscriber, household, identity, precise address, parcel-person, owner, occupant, delivery and query-log data remain gated. NIRA identity numbers are never address identifiers, and NIRA data-sovereignty principles require identity data to stay in authority-managed in-country systems.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared non-personal immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Identity, recipient, subscriber, precise household or address, delivery, credential and sensitive query material stays in approved controlled infrastructure.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID supplies an independent conflict-sensitive spatial fallback and versioned crosswalk. It never becomes an official Somali postcode, civic address, administrative boundary, delivery entitlement, cadastral parcel or identity number, and precise AGID output is suppressed by default for sensitive use cases.
